name: Context Menu
summary: Context-triggered immediate-command menu that consumes canonical Dropdown Menu anatomy and adds pointer/keyboard invocation, target-owned positioning, viewport clamping, focus entry, and dismissal behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Fixed-position menu surface anchored to a context interaction point.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: Inherited labelled group that owns related context commands.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Inherited Dropdown Menu item used for context commands.

anatomy.name: itemShortcut
anatomy.description: Inherited optional hint for a shortcut that the target actually implements.

anatomy.name: separator
anatomy.description: Inherited separator used to group context commands.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default context menu width and item spacing.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible state controlled by the context-menu--open modifier.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: Inherited pointer or roving-focus command highlight.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Inherited unavailable command state that cannot activate.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The context menu is hidden by default and becomes visible when context-menu--open is applied.

behavior.name: entryPoints
behavior.description: The menu should open from pointer contextmenu events and keyboard context menu entry points.

behavior.name: positioning
behavior.description: The menu should position near the invocation point while clamping inside the viewport.

behavior.name: menuSemantics
behavior.description: The inherited groups, labels, items, separators and disabled behavior preserve the canonical Dropdown Menu semantics.

behavior.name: focusNavigation
behavior.description: Opening moves focus into one roving menuitem; arrows, Home, End and optional typeahead navigate, while Tab closes and continues document order.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The menu should close on Escape, outside interaction, viewport changes, or completed commands.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the context menu surface is visible; invocation coordinates and viewport clamping remain target behavior.

accessibility: Provide keyboard access through Shift+F10 or the Menu key when a context menu is available.
Do not make critical actions available only through a context menu.
Use the Dropdown Menu item semantics and disabled behavior for inherited menu items.
Move focus into one roving menuitem while open; support arrows, Home, End and optional printable typeahead.
Restore focus to the invoking element on Escape and completed commands; close safely on outside interaction, scroll and resize.
Keep disabled commands exposed according to target policy but never activatable, and do not advertise shortcut hints that are not implemented.
Use logical inherited item layout and clamp the surface without overflowing narrow or localized viewports.

web.notes: Implemented by bounded surface CSS plus inherited canonical Dropdown Menu classes; targets provide pointer/keyboard invocation, focus navigation, coordinates, collision and dismissal.
